final: SELECT COALESCE(ordertypedist, 'Missing') AS ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_records FROM advancedbehavior INNER JOIN transactionrecord ON advancedbehavior.translink = transactionrecord.transreg WHERE advancedbehavior.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY COALESCE(ordertypedist, 'Missing') ORDER BY matched_records DESC
